# Hexus AI

## Docs

- [How to Add AI Avatars to Your Videos on Hexus](https://support.hexus.ai/advanced-editing/AI-Avatar.md): Make your tutorials more interactive
- [How to Add AI Voiceovers to Your Videos on Hexus](https://support.hexus.ai/advanced-editing/AI-Voiceovers.md): Easily add professional, natural-sounding voiceovers to your videos with just a few clicks
- [How to Edit Images with AI in Your Hexus Flows](https://support.hexus.ai/advanced-editing/ai-image-edit.md): Transform your visual content instantly with AI-powered image editing
- [Edit HTML Product Tours on Hexus](https://support.hexus.ai/advanced-editing/edit-html-tour.md): Transform your HTML product tours with powerful editing tools – no coding required
- [Editing Page Copy](https://support.hexus.ai/advanced-editing/editing-page-copy.md): You can edit the web page copy before or during recording a flow with Hexus. This is great especially for data clean up or personalizing messaging.
- [Embedding Multiformat Filetypes](https://support.hexus.ai/advanced-editing/embedding-multiformat-filetypes.md): You can add multiple assets such as PDFs, Forms, and more at the end of your Hexus Flows to engage your audience even further.
- [How to Find and Replace Images across Hexus Flows](https://support.hexus.ai/advanced-editing/find-replace-images.md): Keep your visual content fresh and consistent across all your flows with just a few clicks
- [Adding a Lead Capture Form](https://support.hexus.ai/advanced-editing/lead-capture-form.md): You can add forms into a product tour to collect viewers' names, emails, feedback, or any other information.
- [Creating Localizations](https://support.hexus.ai/advanced-editing/localization.md): Strengthen customer relationships across regions with the localization capabilities available in Hexus.
- [Creating a Multi-flow Product Tour](https://support.hexus.ai/advanced-editing/multi-flow-product-tour.md): You can create multiple paths, branches, and playlists so your customers always have access to relevant and personalized tours.
- [Personalization Capabilities](https://support.hexus.ai/advanced-editing/personalization.md): Here’s a quick guide on how you can make your interactive product tours and demo centers even more tailored and engaging for your audience.
- [Pronunciation Dictionary ](https://support.hexus.ai/advanced-editing/pronunciation-dictionary.md): Define how words are pronounced in your AI voice and Avatar videos for consistent, natural-sounding voice.
- [Capturing Browser Extension Content in Hexus](https://support.hexus.ai/advanced-editing/record-your-chrome-extension.md): Record browser extension interactions using Hexus, seamlessly with shortcut setups, screen recordings, and video-to-flow conversions
- [Refresh](https://support.hexus.ai/advanced-editing/refresh.md): Hexus offers several ways for content maintenance options when your UI changes. Here are the options.
- [Building a Showcase](https://support.hexus.ai/advanced-editing/showcase.md): A Demo Center is a dedicated page hosted by Hexus that enables you to display your product demos, video tutorials, and interactive guides in one centralized location. It's designed to enhance your customer engagement and streamline the demo experience.
- [Using Regular Expressions](https://support.hexus.ai/advanced-editing/using-regular-expressions.md): Regular expressions, often abbreviated as regex or regexp, are sequences of characters that form search patterns. They are used for matching strings within text and are a powerful tool for searching, replacing, and manipulating text.
- [Video-to-Hexus Conversion](https://support.hexus.ai/advanced-editing/video-to-flow-conversion.md): Hexus makes it easy to convert these into various formats including interactive tours and articles.
- [Analytics and Reporting](https://support.hexus.ai/collaboration/analytics-and-reporting.md): Hexus Analytics, accessible from the left-hand sidebar of your Hexus account, provides you with a comprehensive overview of your demos' performance and user engagement.
- [Collaboration and Organization](https://support.hexus.ai/collaboration/collaboration-and-organization.md): You can invite team members to your workspace and give them role based access if you are on a team plan.
- [Customization](https://support.hexus.ai/collaboration/customization.md): Customize your logo, CTA appearance, colors, add custom assets in the Settings tab on the left.
- [How to Add Different Content Types on Your Showcase Page](https://support.hexus.ai/getting-started/add-content-format-on-showcase.md): Add text-based stories, interactive demos, how-to guides and any external links to your showcase
- [How to Add or Update Your Email and Password on Hexus](https://support.hexus.ai/getting-started/add-password-and-email.md): This guide explains how to manage your account email and password on Hexus
- [Hexus Content Editor Management Tool](https://support.hexus.ai/getting-started/content-editor-management-tool.md): Manage and customize how the Hexus Content Editor replaces HTML text using configurable rules, directly within your Chrome extension.
- [Create a Hexus Flow (Without Chrome Extension)](https://support.hexus.ai/getting-started/create-from-scratch.md): Create a Hexus flow without using the Chrome Extension by uploading videos, images, or importing videos. Perfect for repurposing existing content and getting started quickly
- [Editing Your Tour](https://support.hexus.ai/getting-started/editing-your-tour.md): Learn how to customize your product tour
- [Using the Hexus Chrome Extension](https://support.hexus.ai/getting-started/extension.md): The Hexus extension can be downloaded from the Chrome store or Edge store and supports a variety of capabilites based on your plan.
- [Hexus AI Studio](https://support.hexus.ai/getting-started/hexus-ai-studio.md): Everything you need to know about the AI Studio
- [Welcome to the Hexus Resource Hub](https://support.hexus.ai/getting-started/hexus_resource_hub.md): We're here to answer your questions. Can't find what you're looking for? Send our support team a note at team@hexus.ai
- [How to Record an HTML Capture on Hexus](https://support.hexus.ai/getting-started/html-capture.md): Capture and preserve any web page's HTML structure for a realistic product tour
- [Loom Video Imports on Hexus](https://support.hexus.ai/getting-started/import-loom-video.md): Import Loom videos into Hexus and use them as standalone video steps or convert them into fully interactive Hexus Flows
- [Publishing and Sharing Your Hexus](https://support.hexus.ai/getting-started/publishing-and-sharing.md): Discover all the channels on which you can share your Hexus and engage customers.
- [Repurposing to Other Templates](https://support.hexus.ai/getting-started/repurposing.md): Record once, repurpose indefinitely.
- [Video Recording mode on Chrome Extension](https://support.hexus.ai/getting-started/video-recording-mode.md): Capture your screen as a high-quality video. Record a tab, window, or your full screen for easy sharing and smooth playback.
- [Best Practices](https://support.hexus.ai/guides/best-practices.md): Here are 7 Best Practices for creating engaging Interactive Product Tours
- [Use Cases](https://support.hexus.ai/guides/use-cases.md): Marketing, Customer Success, and Sales can all use Hexus for various customer touchpoints.
- [Google Analytics](https://support.hexus.ai/integrations/analytics.md): Integrate Google Analytics with Hexus to gain deep insights into user behavior and campaign performance.
- [How to Integrate Hexus with Apollo.io](https://support.hexus.ai/integrations/apollo.md): Supercharge your lead management by connecting Hexus with Apollo.io for automated enrichment and outreach
- [GitBook](https://support.hexus.ai/integrations/gitbook.md): On-brand interactive product demos, tutorials created in minutes.
- [Google Drive](https://support.hexus.ai/integrations/google-drive.md): Export your text-based stories and all your Hexus AI Studio chats to your Google Drive
- [Google Workspace](https://support.hexus.ai/integrations/google-workspace.md): Integrate your Google Workspace with Hexus
- [HubSpot](https://support.hexus.ai/integrations/hubspot.md): Optimize lead capture and management from interactive product tours
- [Intercom](https://support.hexus.ai/integrations/intercom.md): Integrate Hexus with your Intercom workflow
- [Marketo](https://support.hexus.ai/integrations/marketo.md): Hexus provides seamless lead data integration with Marketo
- [Salesforce](https://support.hexus.ai/integrations/salesforce.md): Connect Salesforce to Hexus using the following steps
- [Slack](https://support.hexus.ai/integrations/slack.md): Get notified everytime someone submits a form on Hexus tour
